Alex: Heads-up: final launchway handoff sync — need alignment on pricing anchors, SLA numbers, docs owners, and support rota. Are we green to cut GA?
Maria: Quick status: docs - draft done, need API examples and pricing table. Owner: Maria. Link to PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/784
Dave: SLA draft posted in confluence: 99.9% uptime, p99 latency <=200ms for hosted tiers. We should confirm dedicated commitments. Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/INF/pages/GA-SLA
Sara: Support rota: oncall R1 nights covered, need weekend backup and enterprise escalation contact. Proposed rota in this thread: week1 Jamie -> week2 Dave -> week3 Alex
Jamie: Agree. Also pricing anchors: 1) Hosted: $0.03/1k tokens, 2) Dedicated: commit + overage, 3) Private: license + infra. Need product to confirm numbers. cc @Maria
Maria: Confirmed hosted anchor is final for GA: $0.029/1k tokens (intro rate). Need billing SKU names from finops. I'll raise INF-332 for SKU mapping.
Alex: Ops ask: what metrics to monitor day 0? I propose: error_rate, p95_latency, total_tokens_per_min, queue_length, kv_cache_hit. Keep alerts: error_rate >1% for 5m, p95 >300ms for 5m.
Dave: Add model-fallback counts and routing-failures. For Dedicated, add GPU-util > 85% sustained 10m.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary pushed to prod-seed at 2026-03-21T09:12:01Z :rocket:
Sara: Docs checklist snippet:
```
- Overview + onboarding quickstart
- API examples (chat, generate, embeddings) with real payloads
- Pricing table + SKU names
- SLA summary and link to full confluence page
- Private deployment runbook and support escalation matrix
```
Alex: For SLAs, legal wants 'force majeure' clause and uptime window definitions. Can someone confirm we have those in the confluence SLA draft?
Dave: Yes, legal comments addressed in v2. We still need sign-off from finance for the billing terms.
Maria: I'll queue the finance review. TAG: @finops
Jamie: Two open blockers for GA: 1) pricing SKU mapping, 2) support runbook for private installs. Anyone picking up #2?
Alex: Sara can lead private runbook, with eng-platform support. Sara?
Sara: On it. I'll draft runbook today and ping eng-sre for playbook tests.
Dave: Proposed fallback policy for capacity-constrained requests: route to cheaper quantized model with warning header. Want product sign-off.
Alex: Works for me. Maria, ok to include as 'graceful degradation' in docs?
Maria: Yes, will add a short section and sample response header example.
Alex: Great. Action items: Maria: finish docs & pricing PR by EOD; Dave: finalize SLA doc + legal sign-off; Sara: private runbook + weekend rota; Jamie: coordinate finops for SKU mapping. If no major blockers by 5381234120 we'll call green. :thumbsup:
